Grassland    Circle Spells                                A druid holds certain plants to be sacred, particularly alder,
             invisibility, pass without trace             ash, birch, elder, hazel, holly, juniper, mistletoe, oak, rowan,
Druid Level  daylight, haste                              willow, and yew. Druids often use such plants as part of a
3rd          divination, freedom of movement              spellcasting focus, incorporating lengths of oak or yew or
5th          dream, insect plague                         sprigs of mistletoe.
7th
9th                                                          Similarly, a druid uses such woods to make other objects,
                                                          such as weapons and shields. Yew is associated with death
Mountain     Circle Spells                                and rebirth, so weapon handles for scimitars or sickles might
             spider climb, spike growth                   be fashioned from it. Ash is associated with life and oak with
Druid Level  lightning bolt, meld into stone              strength. These woods make excellent hafts or whole
3rd          stone shape, stoneskin                       weapons, such as clubs or quarterstaffs, as well as shields.
5th          passwall, wall of stone                      Alder is associated with air, and it might be used for thrown
7th                                                       weapons, such as darts or javelins.
